notes.title: Localization Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Sometimes the text in the game was not positioned correctly. Now you can enjoy the game in any of the available languages.

notes.title: Rag Doll is now in Espanol!
notes.notes: Added Espanol localization. We are still experiencing random black screens for some players and this issue has been resolved! Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Little Fix
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where the game would hang in the Steam launcher processes when exiting.
We continue to deal with random black screens for some users!

notes.title: Rag Doll is now in Portuguese!
notes.notes: Rag Doll is now playable in Portuguese! Minor bugs have also been fixed!

notes.title: Update 1.202
notes.notes: Fixed a bug with a random black screen and subsequent game crash.
